text: In physical reservoir computing, which part of the system is trained?
choices: The internal couplings of the physical substrate are optimized by gradient descent
Both the physical dynamics and the readout are trained jointly
Only the linear readout is trained (in software); the physical system's own dynamics are left untrained
Nothing is trained; the output is read directly off the physical system
explanation: Physical RC exploits a physical system's intrinsic nonlinear dynamics as the fixed reservoir and trains only a linear readout in software (typically by ridge regression on sampled states). The substrate itself is not optimized (options 0, 1), and a readout must still be fit — the output is not simply the raw physical state (option 3).
